name: Philippines
blurb: Over 7,000 islands of lagoons, reefs and white-sand beaches.
cities: Laid-back surf island with palm-lined roads.
White Beach, sunsets and lively nights.
The Chocolate Hills and tiny tarsiers.
Ancient rice terraces carved into the mountains.
Spanish-era Intramuros and a huge food scene.
Earthquake Baroque churches, from Manila's San Agustín to Paoay's buttressed walls.
Cobbled Calle Crisologo, Spanish colonial houses and horse-drawn kalesa rides.
A Mindanao mountain of pygmy forest and Philippine eagles.
Boat trips into a navigable cave river that flows straight to the sea.
Remote coral atolls in the Sulu Sea, reached only by liveaboard dive boats.
